name: AI代码补全
description: Low-latency AI ghost-text inline code completion powered by OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages endpoints.

enabled.description: Enable AI inline ghost-text code completion in Monaco editors.

providerProtocol.description: LLM endpoint protocol: OpenAI Chat Completions (/v1/chat/completions), Anthropic Messages (/v1/messages with <COMPLETION> prefill), or native OpenAI FIM (/v1/completions).

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible API endpoint.

apiKey.description: API key for authenticating completion requests.

model.description: Model identifier used for low-latency inline completion (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat, qwen2.5-coder-7b, claude-3-5-haiku-latest).

triggerMode.description: Trigger mode: automatic debounced inline completion while typing or manual shortcut trigger only.

manualShortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut to manually trigger inline code completion in the editor (e.g. Alt+\, Ctrl+Shift+Space, Alt+I).

completionScope.description: Completion scope: smart block/single-line detection or strict single-line completion.

ignoredGlobs.description: Comma-separated file glob patterns excluded from context extraction and completion requests.

disabledLanguages.description: Comma-separated language IDs where automatic inline completion is disabled.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated for multi-line block completions.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for code completion generation.
